rows.description: Flags whether the page conforms to Heritage SG brand guidelines and carries the standard government disclaimer (BRD 106/109).
firstFestivalYear content-model field flagging debut programmes/installations (BRD 1104).
Page template/type (programme, installation, trail, privacy, terms, cookie policy). Covers BRD 104/107/108/1812.
Unique AEMaaCS ID of the programme/installation in context (BRD 104).
Mirrors the Programme Name eVar to support content pathing analysis of which programmes/installations visitors traverse. Supports requirement 104.
Display title of the programme/installation (BRD 104).
AEMaaCS publish source/channel (independent author publish vs migration) for content governance reporting (BRD 1102/1103).
Programme date/time window shown on listing detail (BRD 104).
Mirrors the Trail Name eVar to enable pathing analysis of which curated self-guided trails visitors view and follow. Supports requirement 501 (trail presentation).
Whether optional unlocked content is present/visible for a scanned-in visitor (BRD 602/605/1104).
Venue associated with the programme/installation listing (BRD 104/401).
Raw filename of the downloaded document asset.
File format of the downloaded document asset.
Human-readable display name of the downloaded document.
Mirrors the Registration Journey Step eVar to enable PathFinder analysis of the email registration funnel flow. Supports requirement 201 (email registration verification).
Context/moment that triggered the registration prompt (first QR scan, itinerary adoption, etc.) — funnel reporting by trigger (BRD 603/506/1205).
Derived student cohort flag from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source. Not stored as permanent PII; refreshed annually (BRD 1806).
Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (answered, escalated, failed) for engagement/escalation reporting (BRD 1406).
Classified visitor intent for a Brand Concierge query (programme discovery, trail rec, venue info, general) (BRD 1405/1406).
Consent action recorded (grant/withdraw) for the consent log, effective immediately (BRD 303/304).
Cookie consent category states (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting). No pre-ticked acceptance (BRD 1808/1809/1811).
Three-tier consent state (Tier 0 Functional / Tier 1 Festival Marketing / Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Unbundled, unchecked by default (BRD 301/302).
Custom itinerary identifier for created/shared/adopted itineraries incl. Community Picks (BRD 503/506/507).
Native device share channel used for itinerary sharing (no social OAuth) (BRD 505/705).
Type of dismissible inline optimisation suggestion surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (BRD 504).
Active listing sort/auto-sort mode (proximity, current-night, last-chance post-9pm) (BRD 403/404/701).
Location permission grant/deny state driving proximity sorting vs default listing. Geolocation client-side only (BRD 403/404/1802).
[Hashed] Session hash cluster key powering 'Trending with your circle' chip. Non-PII hashed cluster id (BRD 703).
Adobe Target personalisation use case in context (Your picks tonight, Trending with your circle, returning banner) (BRD 702/703/704/706).
Adobe Target activity/experience variant served — supports lift & conversion reporting (BRD 706/1203).
Installation ID captured on a QR check-in scan. Venue check-in derived from QR only, not GPS (BRD 601/604/1803).
Identifies AI-powered / agentic crawler source for GEO & LLMO visibility reporting (BRD 901/902/1303).
Social sharing surface / Open Graph–Twitter Card context on programme detail and shareable itinerary pages (BRD 1001/1002).
Trail progress tracked via QR check-ins — current step / completion ratio (BRD 502).
SAINT classification of s.campaign — creative/content variant.
SAINT classification of s.campaign — medium.
SAINT classification of s.campaign — traffic source.
External campaign tracking code (utm_campaign / cid) — Adobe s.campaign.
Industry vertical associated with the project for cross-client benchmarking.
Unique identifier for the project instance recorded at project creation.
Display name of the project instance recorded at project creation.
Elapsed time in milliseconds spent on the completed step.
ISO-8601 timestamp when the step was completed.
ISO-8601 timestamp when the step was started.
Unique identifier for the completed project step.
Human-readable name of the completed project step.
Ordinal position of the step within the project flow.
Adobe Experience Cloud ID auto-collected by AEP Web SDK. Primary visitor identity.
[Hashed — PII] Registered visitor profile ID, SHA-256 hashed in JS before collection. Never expiration (BRD 204/604/304).
Registered vs unregistered visitor. Registration is optional with full content access (BRD 201/203).
Form or Chat interface the interaction used.
Off-site Klook ticketing CTA destination clicked (exit link). No ticketing built on SNF site (BRD 105).
Visible text label of the interaction element.
Selected curated self-guided trail name (BRD 501/502).
Interaction type on the Bras Basah–Bugis MapBox map (pin tap, zoom, directions). Map by Adobe using MapBox (BRD 401/402).
Business unit / brand owner for the property. Baseline dimension on every hit.
Environment flag (production/staging) powering the Production Data Only segment.
Human-readable page name on every hit (BRD 101).
Numeric page load time in milliseconds. Pairs with Page Load Time Instances to derive Avg Page Load Time calculated metric. Supports BRD 1501-1504 performance monitoring.
Hostname of the server that served the page.
Top-level site section for content grouping across all pages (BRD 101).
Full page URL of the current hit. Baseline dimension for all pages (BRD 101).
HTTP referrer URL for the page view.
Captures the topic selected when a visitor submits a newsletter sign-up form. (BRD 1950)
Fires on successful newsletter sign-up form submission. (BRD 1950)
